about: Phase 02A.1 Knowledge Workspace — one real session, 1440×900 @2x, headless Chrome. Test database only; the designer's own browser layer is never touched.

shots.caption: Default workspace: the ten full profiles linked only through attributes their records share; groups are areas; common ground folded in the footer. Counts, kinds and sources appear on hover and in the inspector.
Selecting Yarrow opens the inspector, which narrows the canvas: profile, coverage strip, values at a glance, flowering by source and place, the designers' words.

Explore connections from the inspector: Yarrow across collections — its cultivar ‘Terra Cotta’ and through it the B beds recipe, Robertson 1929 (dotted: name match only), the survey, local sources, places; attribute groups folded.
Expand in place: double-click Robertson 1929 — its plants join the same picture; Yarrow and everything already drawn keep their places, shared plants are drawn once.
Expand again: B beds adds its members by drawing role; the view zooms to fit, nothing is redrawn from scratch.
Planting recipes · B beds: Layers in the plan legend (schematic, clickable: symbol = member, band = drawing role) above the member list; ink = kinds of knowledge recorded.
Recipe Compare opens on the members with knowledge, ordered by how much is recorded; all 46 one click away. Units in the header, the key under the table.
Plant Library network, expanded in place: double-clicking Yarrow and Red osier dogwood adds their recipes, research, survey and places around them; the shared-attribute network stays as it was.
Plant Library · Compare across the ten full profiles; any cell opens its records.
Seasons: flowering by source and place, never merged — the UK, St. Louis, North America and Greater Vancouver rows differ.
Profiles with the four independent dimensions open (coverage · origin · identity · contribution); counts are plants, one per stable identity.
Designer survey: who answered (aggregate), plants and reasons as a dot matrix, observations in their words, plants listed together.
Robertson 1929: visitor taxa per plant (dashed = name match only) beside the original rows of the selected plant — no overlap.
shots.localOnly: shows rows of the digitised Robertson table (licence not cleared): the image stays in the local research copy and is not published

shots.caption: Research · Curated databases: which source documents which plant, and for which region.
Research · Design literature: functional layers and spatial functions as cited; plant placements derived by rule and marked so.
Local data · Metro Vancouver: place hierarchy, water-rule calendar, local evidence per plant.
Add knowledge opens beside the canvas (no modal): a short name is read as a plant name; a new name becomes a provisional plant with nothing invented.
A sentence is read as a note: Yarrow linked and marked in the canvas, Preference and Metro Vancouver pre-selected from words in the text — visible and changeable. No AI reads it.
Saved: the note sits on Yarrow as ◆ My knowledge (inspector); the plant count is unchanged (151 species = 150 + Acer griseum).
Edit my version of a preset record (Kinnikinnick · MOBOT, St. Louis): yours starts with an empty context — say where it applies.
Saved: Preset (struck through, unchanged) against my version — source “me”, place Metro Vancouver, kind observation.
My knowledge layer: the same network; what is mine is drawn, the rest stays as faded context.
Same exploration, Preset layer: positions are kept; my note and list disappear, nothing else moves. Switching back shows them again in place.
Preset layer: the prepared knowledge exactly as migrated — the MOBOT record in effect, no personal marks.
A pasted list: read as a list; import needs a title and a source; Yarrow twice = one membership; “irrigation” not linked and not counted.
Personal knowledge: per plant what I added, my version against the Preset, the list with its unlinked row, and the full history with undo.
Connections from My knowledge: everything I touched, as a network.
Data & access · LLM access: searchKnowledge() on the knowledge in effect, with place match (same / within / broader / elsewhere) and flags; compared with the Preset run.
